items.text: Among adults with knee osteoarthritis who start the six-week video exercise programme between March 2026 and March 2027, what is the mean change in KOOS-12 summary score from baseline to three months?
items.population: Adults with knee osteoarthritis starting the video programme
items.comparator: Baseline score of the same participants

items.text: How do participants, including those who stopped attending, experience video group exercise, and what makes it workable or unworkable for older, digitally excluded and non-English-speaking participants?
items.population: Participants who completed or stopped the programme

finer: Feasible within staff time and routine data; interesting to the hospital's decision in 2027; novel for a rural and older population; ethical with approved interviews; relevant because it decides whether video can replace some in-person classes.
summary: One quantitative and one qualitative question for a convergent design.
